title: Presets
lead: Edit config/presets.ini. Each preset sets font, track, display name, and one style = line per logical blade. Use Config recipe to reference sections from blade_styles.ini, or pick a Named style directly.
help.summary: How presets connect to blades and styles
help.bladeCount: Blade count — must match logical blades from the Blades page and firmware NUM_BLADES (currently ${slotCount}).
help.configRecipe: Config recipe — style = config smoke_blade loads the [smoke_blade] section from blade_styles.ini.
help.overrides: Overrides — style = config with_vars base=magenta replaces {{base}} for that preset only.
help.accents: Accents — blades 2–4 on a five-blade build typically use accent_* named styles (PWM outputs in blades.ini).
heading.styleLines: Style lines — one per logical blade
hint.footer: ${presetCount} preset${presetSuffix} · ${slotCount} style line${styleSuffix} each · Export on the Export page.
